guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: How each screen works, in a few lines.
guide.stillStuck: Still stuck? Send a Help request during the shift, or ask your lead or manager.

today.title: Today
today.body: Your home for the shift. What waits for your confirmation comes first: your schedule, menu changes, new rules or a note from your manager. Then your shift, your section, pre-shift notes, the 86s and your next side work.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Your week, with doubles as two blocks and the events you work. When the schedule is published or changes, open it and tap I saw it. Ask for time off, set your availability, ask your manager for a swap naming a colleague, or claim an open shift.

tasks.title: Side work
tasks.body: Your opening, service and closing side work. Tap a row to tick it. A camera badge means it needs a photo first: of the work, never of guests. Side work opens when the manager opens the shift.

menu.title: Menu
menu.body: Every dish, drink and wine with photo, ingredients, allergens and pairing. No prices. 86 means sold out for this service. New or changed items ask you to tap I saw it before your shift.

section.title: My section
section.body: Your section on the floor plan for tonight, its tables and seats, the table notes and the requests for you.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: The round button asks for water, a table clear or help in two taps: what, then which table. It goes to the role that handles it, never to a friend. If nobody takes it in 90 seconds, it widens to the whole team and the manager.

notes.title: Table notes
notes.body: Add a short note to a table: allergy with the seat, VIP, occasion or preference. Never write phone numbers or emails. Allergy notes go to the expo, and you see when they confirm.

bar.title: Bar shortages
bar.body: Bartender and barback own every bottle running out. Mark an item Low or Out as soon as you see it; the head bartender or manager marks it Restocked or Ordered.

pass.title: Pass
pass.body: The expo's view: allergy notes to confirm with table and seat, the 86s and the floor plan with seats. No ticket, no plate.

preshift.title: Pre-shift
preshift.body: Leads and managers write the notes said at pre-shift and mark 86s. They reach everyone working and expire at close.

floor.title: Floor map
floor.body: Leads: assign today's sections and see who is where, the table notes and the open requests on the live map.

messages.title: Announcements
messages.body: News from your managers, one way. When an announcement asks for it, tap I saw it so they know it reached you. There are no replies or chats.

rules.title: House rules
rules.body: The rules of the company, your venue and your position. When they change, read them and tap I saw it before your next shift.

warnings.title: Notes from your manager
warnings.body: A note always points to one house rule and says how to do it right. Confirm you saw it and, if you want, add your side: it goes to the manager, never to colleagues. Notes stop counting after 30 days.

propose.title: Propose a warning
propose.body: Area leads propose a warning for their own team: the person, the rule, minor or major, what happened. The manager on duty issues it or discards it; after 24 hours it goes to the general manager.

me.title: Me
me.body: Your notes and state, your position and career ladder, language, Large text, theme and notifications, password and sign out.

manage.title: Shift control
manage.body: Open the shift, watch side work by person and area, assign sections, start closing. Everything is recorded.

manageSchedule.title: Building the schedule
manageSchedule.body: Build the week by area, staff the events, publish. Everyone scheduled is notified and confirms; a change after publishing notifies only the people affected. Decide swaps, open shifts and time off.

issue.title: Issuing warnings
issue.body: Managers issue the proposals of the leads or issue directly. Always tied to a rule; the content never appears in notifications. Void within 24 hours with a reason.

close.title: The close
close.body: Incidents, attendance, side work still open, open shortages, 86s, cleaning and notes for the next shift. No money. Submitting locks the shift.

team.title: Team
team.body: Your people by area, with their state in words and their positions. Promotions are proposed here.

venue.title: Venue state
venue.body: On track, Needs attention or Action required, with the reasons in words and the names behind them.

company.title: Company
company.body: The four venues, each with one overall state and its reasons, the organization chart and the company setup.

guide.trainingBody: What to master in your position, and in the next step of your ladder. Your leaders sign it off with you.

polisher.i1: Polish glasses by the stem, never by the rim
polisher.i3: Fold napkins to the house standard
polisher.i4: Read your schedule and confirm it

busser.i1: Reset a table in under two minutes
busser.i2: Water and bread without being asked
busser.i3: Clear between courses from the right side

runner.i1: Learn every table number and seat
runner.i3: Name each dish and its allergens at the table

server.i2: Note every allergy with the seat
server.i3: Guide the guest through food, drinks and wine
server.i4: Confirm menu changes before your shift

captain.i2: Read the live map and answer help
captain.i3: Train new staff in your zone
captain.i4: Propose warnings through the system, never in chats

host.i3: Keep the book up to date
host.i4: Hand over the book at the end

maitre_d.i2: Walk the whole room every hour

expo.i1: Read every ticket before the plate leaves
expo.i2: Confirm allergy notes by table and seat
expo.i3: Publish 86s as soon as the line calls them
expo.i4: Call times to the line clearly

barback.i1: Keep ice, glassware and garnish stocked
barback.i2: Mark bottles Low before they run out
barback.i4: Close the bar side work with photos

bartender.i1: Know every drink on the menu

head_bartender.i4: Propose bar warnings through the system

sommelier.i1: Know the wine list and its pairings
sommelier.i3: Brief servers on pairings at pre-shift

dishwasher.i3: Take out trash and recycling at close
dishwasher.i4: Read your schedule and confirm it

prep_cook.i1: Finish the prep list of the day

sous_chef.i3: Write kitchen notes for the close
sous_chef.i4: Propose kitchen warnings through the system
